idea-plugin.name: Project Tab Icons
idea-plugin.description: Shows project icons, configurable outlines and optional colored fills in macOS window tabs. Enable tab customization globally and choose Custom, Default, Filled, Bold or Dzen appearance presets. Preview changes in a miniature IDE window with macOS traffic lights, a toolbar, three project tabs and an editor fragment. Choose bottom, rounded or full outlines from 1 to 6 px. Choose one letter or two initials in uppercase or mixed case (Ab), with normal or bold text for generated letter icons. Toggle icons and outlines independently, and choose Small (20 px), Medium (24 px) or Large (28 px). Position the close button and icon independently on either side without shifting the title. Show or hide project paths in tabs, with a live preview. Adjust tab height from 30 to 60 px. Icons are displayed without plugin-added backgrounds. Saved project SVGs are preserved. Corners follow the current theme. Manage all open projects in a compact table with separate icon, outline and tab colors. Fill tabs at 50% opacity, matching the icon color by default, with an optional 0–6 px edge inset. Search and browse 121 filled icons by name or category, select a color with the IDE color picker, or reuse a custom SVG from a project. Custom icons follow the IDE's project icon settings; generated letter icons have centered text and padding. Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 or a later 2026.2 update, with project windows merged into tabs. Selected icons are saved as native project SVG files.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Show the current Git branch before or after the project name when project paths are hidden. Keep the ending of long branch names visible and preview both positions live.
